Government of India
Directorate General of Health Services
Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi
~ (New Drugs Division)
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road,
New Delhi,
To
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Prescribing Information Leaflet change for “Olanzapine” marketed in
the country- Reg.
Sir,
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India
(NCC-PvPI), functioning at IPC, Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation
based on ADR reports on Olanzapine which was discussed by them in the 20"
Signal Review Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting held on 11.03.2022
with an objective to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from
Indian database and promote patient safety.
In the meeting, PvP! has evaluated the reported ADRs for Olanzapine on the
basis of Individual Case Study Reports (ICSRs) and recommended CDSCO to
take necessary steps to incorporate Hyponatraemia as an adverse effect in ihe
Prescribing !nformation Leaflet (PIL) of Olanzapine marketed in the country.
Subsequently, PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Neurology & Psychiatry) meeting held on 21.06.2022 at
~ CDSCO (HQ), New Delhi.

After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended that CDSCO should
request the State Drugs Controllers to direct the manufacturers of the drug to
include Hyponatraemia as an adverse effect in the package insert of the drug as
suggested by PvPI.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Olanzapine under
your jurisdiction to incorporate Hyponatraemia as an adverse effect in the
package insert/promotional literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
; Yours faithfully,
\
Dr. V.G. Somani
Drugs Controller General {!ndia)
